rationale: Chose to hold the task until the proof run passes, then raise it with the operator. Strongest objection: a stored key is the classic exfiltration target and every day it exists is exposure. It survives only partly: the key is reachable solely by a job the maintainer approves and the console spend limit caps the loss, while changing the credential path before the first end-to-end run would leave two unknowns in one proof. Not filing at all would lose the item. Note 2026-11-16: the first proof run (43939762163) failed on a sandbox defect (AISDLC-1291), so the hold continues.
